row.sso_plan: Basics + Advanced Security add-on (SSO also listed on Enterprise)
row.evidence: Teamwork.com's help centre documents only SAML SSO with just-in-time auto-provisioning (via the paid Advanced Security add-on); no SCIM endpoint appears in its pricing page, help-centre sitemap or API reference.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> none (absence, medium): June's 'SCIM on Enterprise' has no first-party source; Teamwork documents SAML SSO with JIT auto-provisioning only, and the help-centre sitemap, API reference and pricing page contain no SCIM or IdP provisioning docs. Plans changed since June (Deliver/Grow/Scale -> Basics $9.99, Accelerate $24.99, Optimize and Enterprise 'Let's talk', all per user/month billed yearly; Basics min 3 users, Accelerate min 5). SSO is a paid Advanced Security add-on on paid per-user plans (help centre) and is also listed under Enterprise on the pricing page. User REST API (v1/v3 people endpoints) is on all plans including Free, with plan-based rate limits. Deleting a user does not reduce the paid seat count automatically.

rate_limits.text: Plan-based: 150 requests/minute on Free, Basics and Accelerate per the pricing table; higher on Optimize/Enterprise.

limitations.text: Deleting a paid user does not remove the seat from the subscription.

okta.notes: Teamwork's Okta guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app; okta.com/integrations/teamwork/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn has an SSO tutorial only; no provisioning tutorial (404).

google.notes: Teamwork documents Google Workspace SAML SSO only.
